name: Progress

guidance.useWhen: Use for work with a meaningful completion state, using a value for determinate progress or omitting it for indeterminate progress.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for generic loading placeholders without meaningful progress; use LoadingState or Skeleton instead.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Use the Native HTML Progress renderer when targeting @vyrnforge/ui-elements. Keep value and max as presentation inputs and do not invent completion events or a stateful controller.

accessibility: Preserve native progress semantics: determinate progress exposes the current value and maximum, while omitting value represents indeterminate progress. Provide an accessible name when surrounding context does not.
preserves native progressbar semantics for determinate and indeterminate states
determinate progress exposes the current value and maximum while a null value represents indeterminate progress
progress must have an accessible name when surrounding context does not provide one
knownLimitations: Avoid for generic loading placeholders without meaningful progress; use LoadingState or Skeleton instead.
